name: @btkulka/model-viewer
description: A three.js viewer for 3D models on disk: .glb, .gltf, .obj (with its .mtl) and sets of OBJ parts named in a sidecar (TRELLIS colour groups, toejam's Blender exports, drawn in the sidecar's colours). Drag to turn, scroll to zoom, a turntable, lit and unlit (base colour) shading, wireframe, a three-quarter view, and thumbnails from one shared offscreen renderer. Reads files through a function the app hands in, so the same viewer draws from an Electron protocol, an MCP Apps chat block's file() or fetch. ESM for apps that bundle, and one self-contained script (window.ModelView) for a page that can't load modules.
